title: A counterexample to Eremenko's conjecture
summary: The escaping set of a transcendental entire function consists of those points that tend to infinity under iteration. Eremenko asked whether every connected component of this set is unbounded. In arXiv:2108.10256, we constructed transcendental entire functions for which the escaping set has prescribed compact connected components; in particular, it may have a singleton component. This disproves the conjecture. In this note, we give an introduction to the problem, aimed at a general mathematical audience.
